samples._comment: Fresh saved-state Morning PIE 2026-10-04 shows the existing CuteIdle V10 upright with relaxed arms and planted feet. The Idle state already uses it looping at 0.6; speed-zero now shares that pose and timing. RootX currently renders a static T-pose and is retired from runtime, despite its historical approval.

axis_settings._horizontal_range_comment: Max raised 630 -> 750. The sprint gate records 714 uu/s; an axis capped at 630 (or the Hybrid's 650) clamps sprint and the top of the range is never reachable.
